name: Ravi
label: Lossless audio seeker
who: I have a decent headphone and DAC setup and I care a lot about lossless audio quality. I have tried Apple Music, Tidal, and Deezer for their hi-fi options and I want Spotify to offer lossless without an extra fee.
value_for_money: Mixed. Believes lossless should be included in Spotify rather than sold as an add-on, and says other services already offer it at the same price.
loyalty: Stays for playlists and discovery but has moved to other services for lossless audio. Lossless quality is the main reason they give for switching.
pain_points: Bluetooth headphones limit how much lossless quality you can hear
Hard to tell lossless and high-bitrate audio apart
Other services charge extra for hi-fi
tone: Detail-oriented and technical, comparing bitrates and gear, sometimes with frustration about missing features.
